scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide inline picture-book painting for a Japanese graded-reading chapter
Input images: Image 1 is the character and palette reference: Riku is 13, Japanese, with short dark hair, a pale grey shirt, dark shorts and a black backpack. Keep the story's restrained coastal palette; do not copy the cover composition.
Primary request: illustrate the opening of chapter one of Three Bells, after the prose introduces the island and its wooden tower.
Scene/backdrop: Early August afternoon in the small Japanese fishing town of Shiomi. A modest harbour lies directly beyond a quiet bus stop.
Subject: Riku, seen mostly from behind in the near foreground, has just arrived and looks across the harbour at a low rocky island with a wooded high point and a small timber tower. Something dark and round hangs beneath the distant tower roof, too small to identify.
Style/medium: softly painted storybook gouache, broad smooth colour shapes, gentle contours, restrained surface texture, simple expressive character design consistent with the supplied cover.
Composition/framing: wide landscape, around 12:7; small clear view of Riku near the foreground, calm open water across the middle, island and tower as distant focal point; uncluttered, readable at phone width.
Lighting/mood: warm natural afternoon light; quiet, inviting arrival with a hint of mystery.
Color palette: warm ivory sky, muted teal harbour water, sage and deep indigo island, ochre shoreline, tiny terracotta accent only if natural.
Constraints: child-appropriate Japanese coast; original character design; one boy only, one distant timber tower and only one small indistinct dark hanging shape; no legible text, no supernatural elements; useful wide composition with calm edges.
Avoid: multiple bells, clear bell detail, sunset or night, storm, danger, flooding, sand road, stranger, later clues, photo realism, action posing, lettering, labels, border, logo, watermark.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: second wide inline painting for Three Bells, chapter one
Input images: Image 1 is the series cover reference for both teenagers and the coastal palette; Image 2 is the revised Riku and the matching painted style reference.
Primary request: show the moment Riku notices the altered tide table in his aunt's harbour shop.
Scene/backdrop: Inside a modest Japanese fishing-town shop in Shiomi, late summer afternoon. A small counter with a till, shelves of bread, vegetables and fishing tackle. A paper tide table is pinned beside the till.
Subject: Riku, thirteen, with short dark hair, a pale grey shirt, dark shorts and black backpack, stands at the counter looking up at the paper with curiosity. His middle-aged Japanese aunt stands behind the counter, one hand near the till and her gaze lowered as she answers him. Give her natural proportions, dark hair in a neat low bun, muted sage apron over a simple warm ivory blouse.
Composition/framing: landscape 12:7, medium-wide interior view; make the paper table visible on the wall and both people clearly readable at phone width, with the paper a small story prop rather than an infographic.
Style/medium: softly painted storybook gouache matching Image 2, confident natural silhouettes, broad colour areas, restrained brush texture, delicate but limited shop details.
Lighting/mood: gentle afternoon daylight from the open shop front; an ordinary welcoming shop with a small uneasy pause.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted teal, sage, deep indigo, ochre, touches of terracotta; calm coastal light.
Constraints: represent the tide table with a clear printed grid and one row of faint pencil marks written over the print, but no readable words, dates or numbers. Show only Riku and his aunt. Preserve the sense that this is an ordinary shop.
Avoid: legible text, readable numbers, extra people, Chika, clocks, phones being used, bell imagery, supernatural elements, any hint of the island's history or later clues, border, caption, logo, watermark.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: third wide inline painting for Three Bells, chapter one
Input images: Image 1 is the series cover reference for Riku, Chika and the coastal palette; Image 2 is the revised Riku and matching painted style reference.
Primary request: show Riku and Chika reaching the sea wall and spotting the lone torch on the sand road.
Scene/backdrop: Shiomi coast at early evening, after sunset but with a band of fading warm sky. The tide is beginning to cover the narrowest low dip in the exposed sand road leading from shore to a small wooded island.
Subject: Riku, thirteen, in his pale grey short-sleeved shirt, dark shorts and black backpack, and Chika, a Japanese girl of similar age with dark hair tied back, a rust-orange top and light neutral skirt as in Image 1, are seen from behind near the top of the sea wall. Chika is calling toward the island while Riku looks on. A single tiny torch-light moves about halfway along the road; no figure can be identified at that distance.
Composition/framing: landscape 12:7, medium-wide view from behind the two teenagers, their silhouettes at one side of the foreground, white sand road and small distant torch as the focal line across dark teal water. The tower is a quiet silhouette on the island; no detail beneath its roof is discernible.
Style/medium: softly painted storybook gouache matching Image 2, natural teen proportions, broad smooth colour shapes, controlled brush texture and simple distant forms.
Lighting/mood: dusk after a warm summer day; suspenseful and child-appropriate, not frightening.
Color palette: fading warm ivory and ochre sky, muted teal and midnight indigo water, sage island, restrained terracotta in Chika's top.
Constraints: show only Riku and Chika in the foreground, one distant point of torchlight about halfway to the island, and dark water just beginning to cover part of the road's low dip while most of the road remains visible. No readable text.
Avoid: a clear person on the road, a fully disappeared road, the light already reaching the island, rescue boats or other lights, storm or waves, any clearly identifiable bell, clues from later chapters, border, caption, logo, watermark.

edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: replace the first inline painting for Three Bells chapter one
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target; preserve the existing illustration and its composition
Primary request: make only the hanging dark shape beneath the distant island tower roof much smaller and ambiguous, so viewers cannot tell it is a bell
Constraints: Keep Riku, his clothing and backpack, harbor, boats, shore, island, trees, timber tower, sky, light, colors, painterly style, framing, and all other details exactly as they are. Reduce the hanging shape to a tiny low-contrast irregular charcoal shadow partially obscured by the tower's wooden supports, with no clear outline, clapper, rim, metal shine or bell-like silhouette. At the displayed phone width it should read only as an indistinct dark mark. Keep one tower and one mark; do not remove the tower or the entire mark.
Avoid: changing any other part of the illustration, adding or removing objects, making any part of the tower or hanging shape more prominent, text, lettering, border, logo, watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: replace the third inline painting for Three Bells chapter one
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target; preserve the full dusk scene and composition
Primary request: make the small hanging shape beneath the distant island tower roof as tiny and ambiguous as it is in the revised first illustration
Constraints: Keep Riku, Chika, their clothing, sea wall, sand road, single torch, water, island, trees, timber tower, sky, lighting, colors, painterly style, framing and all other details exactly as they are. Reduce only the hanging shape to a tiny low-contrast irregular charcoal speck partly hidden behind the tower's central wooden support. It must have no bell-like outline, clapper, rim, metal shine or visible structure. Match the first illustration's visual treatment: at 360px-wide phone display the mark should be only a faint, indistinct shadow a few pixels wide. Keep one tiny mark; do not remove the tower or the shape entirely.
Avoid: recognizable bell, large or clear hanging object, changing the torch or tide, changing any other part of the image, adding objects, text, lettering, border, logo, watermark.

selectedVersion: First and third paintings retouched to obscure the hanging shape; two new paintings added, 25 September 2026.
